requirement_vague: Deleting a user as admin should also delete all their items. Admin credentials: admin@example.com / password123
requirement_precise: Register a new user via signup and authenticate to get a token. Create an item using that token. Store the item ID from the response. As superuser (admin@example.com / password123), delete the user by ID. Verify 200 status with message 'User deleted successfully'. Using the superuser token, attempt to GET the item by ID. Verify it returns 404 with detail 'Item not found'.

implementation.reasoning: The admin credentials are initialized at startup with email admin@example.com and password password123. When an admin deletes a user via DELETE /api/v1/users/{user_id}, the SQLModel relationship on User.items is configured with cascade delete-orphan, so the user's items are deleted as well; afterward, GET /api/v1/items/{item_id} returns 404 with detail 'Item not found' because the item no longer exists.
